hook_text: Look down at a jug and you will read it wrong. Here is the one move that fixes it.
clip_script: Ginger beer day in Welkom! Three tablespoons of ginger: 15 ml each, so 45 ml. Two cups of sugar: 500 ml. Now the jug. Numbers every 200, three marks between. Four spaces: 50 ml each! Bend down, eyes level with the water. Second mark after 400: 500 ml! And which holds more, 1,5 l or 1 250 ml? Make them both millilitres: 1 500 wins!
visual_style: A warm kitchen with a big glass jug, the camera dropping to eye level as the water line glows against the marks.
mood: Homely and festive, like a family get-together.
pacing: Quick spoon and cup shots, a slow eye-level moment, then a fast comparison.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find three containers with their capacity printed on them.
